entries.title: C0029 source correction: real Gaussian finite and limiting laws
entries.statement: DRAFT source correction, independent review pending. For an n by n real Gaussian matrix with independent N(0,1) entries, the CDF of sqrt(n)s_min converges, at each fixed t>=0, to F(t)=1-exp(-t-t^2/2). This is not an exact finite-n identity: at n=1 the CDF is erf(t/sqrt(2)), with right derivative sqrt(2/pi) at zero, while F has derivative one. The C0029-A001 exact-law wording must retain the limiting qualifier. This correction does not solve the Bernoulli conjecture.
assumptions: fixed t>=0 before n tends to infinity
source audit is pending referee acceptance

entries.title: C0029 draft obstruction to combining scalar universality bounds
entries.statement: DRAFT author-derived scalar obstruction; w569 independent review pending. Let F(t)=1-exp(-t-t^2/2), eta_n=(log(n+e))^(-1/16), a_n=exp(-sqrt(n)), q_n=2^(-n), m_n=eta_n F(a_n)/2. For t>=0 set G_n(t)=q_n+(1-q_n)[(1-m_n)F(t)+m_n 1_{t>=a_n}], and set G_n(t)=0 for t<0. These CDFs have G_n(0)=q_n, uniform error |G_n-F|<=(eta_n/2)F+q_n, and G_n(t)<=(3/2)t+q_n. For every fixed d>0, eventually G_n(t)<=t for all t>=n^(-d). Yet eventually G_n(a_n)-a_n>=eta_n a_n/16, which defeats every bound t+C exp(-cn) with fixed C,c>0. The reference F is limiting; no realization by iid Bernoulli matrices or counterexample to their conjecture is asserted.
assumptions: d is fixed before the eventual dimension threshold
no finite-n Gaussian comparison or Bernoulli realization is asserted

relations.rationale: The existing C0029-A001 card says exact real-Gaussian law; this draft provides the finite-n counterexample and limiting-law qualifier.
The target requires exact coefficient one at small scales; the scalar example identifies why endpoint and relative-error estimates alone do not fill that window.
Both entries require distinguishing the limiting reference law from the finite-n law; the scalar construction does not claim to instantiate the matrix comparison theorem.
